purpose: Read-only source/artifact data-identity inventory; no model quality/registration/tier review or claim-credit acceptance
selection_scope: uniform sample of three from seven explicitly predeclared publisher-released pretrained causal LMs; not a Hub-wide random sample

hash_method.algorithm: SHA-256 over entire file streamed in 1 MiB chunks
hash_method.checks: path stat before/open fd/after fd/path stat after, realpath before/after
hash_method.limitations: No atomic filesystem snapshot; equal observed stats are a stability check, not external publisher authentication. Only assigned model tree and directly referenced cohort metadata were examined.

checkpoint.publisher_revision_evidence: Existing pinned source-manifest, hub-info, selection, pack and run agree; no network request was made.
checkpoint.git_lfs_pointer_note: source-manifest.git_blob_sha1 for model.safetensors identifies its 134-byte Git LFS pointer; it is reproduced separately. The full physical checkpoint payload SHA256 matches both LFS oid and source/pack records.

declared_identity.status: Existing declarations only; class digest recomputation uses the recorded inventory root, not a newly reconstructed weight root.

artifact_containers.inventory_root_recomputation: NOT_RUN; inventory root retained from existing metadata, not reconstructed from tensors
NOT_RUN; inventory root retained from existing metadata, not reconstructed from tensors
NOT_RUN; inventory root retained from existing metadata, not reconstructed from tensors

cross_checks.method: Reconstructed canonical LFS pointer from recorded oid/size; SHA1 blob header + pointer. Physical payload SHA256 is checked separately.

cross_checks.classification: Byte difference limited to spaces listing; repository revision, model config metadata and sibling byte/hash records agree.

mismatches.classification: Byte difference limited to spaces listing; repository revision, model config metadata and sibling byte/hash records agree.

summary.scope: Inventory data identity only; no computation/native/model-tier acceptance

artifact_stage_distinctions.note: Existing base and declared containers have different original program bytes/graph roots. pack.result.graph_ir_root describes the base container; the recorded declared class is derived from the declared program, layout, tokenizer and recorded inventory root. No artifact was changed by this inventory.
artifact_stage_distinctions.differing_program_region: All differences are within the original final 64 bytes; no earlier program byte differs. Declared and early-declared program bytes are equal.
